notes.title: Pubblety graduated!
notes.content: [h2]Happy International Cat Day! [/h2][h1]And not only:[/h1][p][/p][p]It has been... 3 years... of a great journey.[/p][p]And with today, I officially [b]graduated from Game Design University[/b] with a Bachelor's degree,[/p][p]with [b][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3625080/Mr_Pubblety_Meows/" buttoncolor="#fba037"]Pubblety[/url] as my graduation thesis/project[/b]. He did good. [u]Extremely good[/u]. [u][b]Ultimate Domination[/b][/u].[/p][p][/p][p]Though this marks the end of one journey, others are just beginning.[/p][p]Works on [b][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3625080/Mr_Pubblety_Meows/"]Mr. Pubblety Meows[/url][/b] are only just beginning, so-[/p][p]See you all out there~[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45639326/7f5db094f1274c5d439379fd01a4b3b3b5f5aeb1.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Steam Page is live!
notes.content: [h3]I have just one thing to say: My great appreciations to all of you who have helped me until this point, I wouldn't have managed so without you~ <3[/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45639326/91d4ba52a4d2f604576a527cfec31b71001975f8.png"][/img][/p]
